styles.char: Polished stylized 3D character render for a premium fantasy mobile strategy card game, Supercell-quality art. Chunky, cute-but-heroic toy-like proportions with a slightly oversized head, bold readable silhouette, saturated colors, smooth hand-painted textures, soft warm studio lighting with a gentle rim light. Royal blue (#2f6bff) is the team accent color on cloth, plumes, banners and trims, with gold details.

items.name: m3d_knight
items.subject: A sturdy chibi knight in shining silver plate armor with gold trim, a royal blue plume on top of his helmet with the visor open showing a determined face, a short royal blue cape, a broadsword held in his right hand pointing down, a kite shield with a gold lion emblem strapped on his left forearm.

items.name: m3d_archer
items.subject: A young chibi elven archer girl with a royal blue hooded cloak, pink hair in a braid, leather armor, a wooden longbow held in her left hand pointing down, a quiver of arrows on her back.

items.name: m3d_imp
items.subject: A small mischievous chibi green-skinned goblin imp with huge pointy ears and a toothy grin, wearing a tiny royal blue bandana and leather rags, a crude curved dagger in his right hand.

items.name: m3d_brute
items.subject: A huge hulking chibi stone golem made of grey boulders with moss on its shoulders, massive rocky fists, short thick legs, glowing warm amber eyes, a royal blue sash with a gold buckle across its chest.

items.name: m3d_ironclad
items.subject: A compact intimidating chibi warrior in full dark gunmetal steel plate armor with a closed helmet with a glowing icy-white visor slit, a royal blue tabard, an enormous two-handed broadsword held in the right hand pointing down.

items.name: m3d_gunner
items.subject: A stout chibi bearded dwarf gunner with brass goggles on his iron helmet, a royal blue long coat with gold buttons, a big brass blunderbuss rifle held in his right hand pointing down.

items.name: m3d_pyromancer
items.subject: A chibi old fire wizard with a tall pointed royal blue hat, flowing royal blue robes with gold trim, a long white beard, a wooden staff with a glowing orange crystal held in his right hand.

items.name: m3d_berserker
items.subject: A fierce chibi red-haired viking shieldmaiden with braids, a royal blue fur-trimmed tunic, leather boots, a huge double-bladed battle axe held in her right hand pointing down.

items.name: m3d_skeleton
items.subject: A small goofy chibi cartoon skeleton warrior with ivory bones, a tattered royal blue scarf, a short rusty sword in its right hand and a small round wooden shield on its left arm.

items.name: m3d_wyrmling
items.subject: A cute chubby chibi baby dragon with royal blue scales, a cream colored belly, small gold horns, big friendly eyes and a short tail.

items.name: m3d_gargoyle
items.subject: A small chibi grey stone gargoyle creature with bat-like wings, little curved horns, glowing blue eyes, sharp claws and a royal blue loincloth.

items.name: m3d_boar
items.subject: A chibi armored brown war boar with big curved tusks, a royal blue saddle cloth with gold trim, and an empty leather saddle on its back.

items.name: m3d_horse
items.subject: A chibi white warhorse with a royal blue caparison with gold trim, an armored head plate, and an empty saddle on its back.

items.name: m3d_rider
items.subject: A wild chibi barbarian with a tall mohawk, royal blue war paint, fur shorts and leather straps, a big war hammer held in his right hand.

items.name: m3d_lancer
items.subject: A heroic chibi armored knight lancer with a plumed helmet, silver armor with royal blue and gold trim, a long jousting lance held upright in his right hand.

items.name: m3d_blimp
items.subject: A small round hot-air balloon bomber with a royal blue and gold striped balloon, ropes and a wooden basket hanging below loaded with big round black bombs, a tiny goblin pilot with goggles in the basket.

items.name: m3d_turret
items.subject: A sturdy wooden and iron defensive ballista crossbow turret on a round stone base, loaded with a giant iron-tipped bolt, small royal blue pennant flags.

items.name: m3d_imphut
items.subject: A crooked little goblin hut made of wooden planks with a straw roof and patched cloth, a royal blue flag on a stick on top, a warm glowing round doorway.

items.name: m3d_keep
items.subject: A chunky fortified square stone castle keep tower with crenellated battlements and gold trim, a big bronze cannon on the top platform, royal blue banners with a gold crown emblem on the walls.

items.name: m3d_watch
items.subject: A chunky round stone watchtower with crenellations around an open top platform, royal blue banners hanging on its sides, gold trim, a wooden door at the base.
